A glimmering veil that wraps your skin in full-throttle sparkle from every angle.

beauty.name: Marshmallow Spritz Me! Hair & Body Mist
beauty.description: El pronóstico de belleza de la temporada: la colección Marshmallow de edición limitada, de crema dulce, malvavisco esponjoso y comodidad acogedora; sin alcohol.
beauty.description_en:
The holiday beauty forecast? Soft and fluffy, with a side of sweetness. This limited-edition Marshmallow Body Care collection is what dreams are made of.  
 FEELS LIKE: Easy-breezy, light n’ spritzy. 
 SMELLS LIKE: Sweet cream, marshmallow fluff and cozy comfort. 
 A little bit of fragrance and a little bit skin care, this spritz-all-over-me-now! formula is the essence of effortless. It’s infused with skin-and-hair friendly Hyaluronic Acid and Vitamin B5—and zero alcohol. 
 HOW TO 
 No rules here—just spritz and enjoy. Good to mist on skin, face, and hair, it’s a sweet, “whenever, whenever” way to help you feel more hydrated. 
 GOOD TO KNOW 
 Hair & Body Mists are part of our Body Care Collection and therefore are lighter in fragrance strength than our Fragrance Body Mists. 
 • 8 fl oz 
 • Formulated Without Artificial Dyes 
 • Dermatologist Approved 
 • Against Animal Testing 
 • Vegan 
 • Packaging Partially Made with Recycled Material

Introducing SHINE by PINK 
 FIND YOUR INNER SPARKLE

beauty.description_en:
Pink by Pink Eau de Parfum Travel Spray 
 Our best-selling signature scent, in TSA-approved, purse-sized form. 
 Whether you’re flying with it or just trying it, this teeny travel size eau de parfum spritzer is the perfect way to keep this one-of-a-kind scent close by. 
 Introducing our new signature scent, Pink by PINK Eau de Parfum. 
 It sparkles. It smiles. It’s the essence of Pink. A one-of-a-kind whirl of juicy apple, creamy jasmine and sparkling cedarwood, Pink by PINK Eau de Parfum has something for everyone to love. A little sweet, a little floral, a little clean, it’s a uniquely easy, wearable, everyday scent for you to make your own, and fall in love with day after day. 
 Top Note: JUICY APPLE 
 An irresistible hook—bright and airy. 
 Mid Note: CREAMY JASMINE 
 Petal-y sheer and feminine. 
 Base Note: SPARKLING CEDARWOOD 
 Warm, modern, and iconic. 
 • Vegan 
 • Against Animal Testing 
 • Dye-Free 
 • Made with Essential Oils 
 • 7ml/ .23 fl oz
